message:
Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src-vul/opensc/src/tests/fuzzing/fuzz_pkcs15_reader.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":118,"var":"Data/Size","code":"fuzz_add_reader(ctx, Data, Size);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes become the backing store for the synthetic reader and drive all later card responses.","depends_on":[]},
{"step":2,"file":"src-vul/opensc/src/tests/fuzzing/fuzz_pkcs15_reader.c","function":"fuzz_reader_connect","line":88,"var":"reader->atr.value","code":"fuzz_get_chunk(reader, &chunk, &chunk_size);","note":"The first chunk from the input is copied into the ATR, influencing card identification and emulation selection.","depends_on":[{"on":1,"type":"data","via":"input bytes"}]},
{"step":3,"file":"src-vul/opensc/src/libopensc/pkcs15-syn.c","function":"sc_pkcs15_bind_synthetic","line":34,"var":"builtin_emulators[]","code":"{ \"coolkey\", sc_pkcs15emu_coolkey_init_ex },","note":"The synthetic card is matched against the built-in Coolkey emulator, routing execution into the vulnerable initialization path.","depends_on":[{"on":2,"type":"control","via":"ATR-driven card type / emulator selection"}]},
{"step":4,"file":"src-vul/opensc/src/libopensc/pkcs15-coolkey.c","function":"sc_pkcs15emu_coolkey_init_ex","line":715,"var":"rv","code":"rv = coolkey_detect_card(p15card);","note":"The detected Coolkey card proceeds into the Coolkey PKCS#15 initializer, which enumerates card objects from attacker-influenced responses.","depends_on":[{"on":3,"type":"control","via":"selected emulator"}]},
{"step":5,"file":"src-vul/opensc/src/libopensc/pkcs15-coolkey.c","function":"sc_pkcs15emu_coolkey_init","line":560,"var":"count / coolkey_obj","code":"r = (card->ops->card_ctl)(card, SC_CARDCTL_COOLKEY_GET_NEXT_OBJECT, &coolkey_obj);","note":"Object metadata is fetched from the synthetic reader; malformed lengths and fields from the input shape the object list and attributes.","depends_on":[{"on":1,"type":"data","via":"subsequent fuzz chunks"}]},
{"step":6,"file":"src-vul/opensc/src/libopensc/pkcs15-syn.c","function":"sc_pkcs15emu_object_add","line":386,"var":"data_len","code":"memcpy(obj->data, data, data_len);","note":"The emulator copies a fixed-size PKCS#15 info structure into a newly allocated object, using fields derived from the attacker-controlled Coolkey object.","depends_on":[{"on":5,"type":"data","via":"object attributes"}]},
{"step":7,"file":"src-vul/opensc/src/libopensc/pkcs15-coolkey.c","function":"sc_pkcs15emu_coolkey_init","line":676,"var":"obj->label","code":"memcpy(obj->label, cert_object->label, SC_PKCS15_MAX_LABEL_SIZE);","note":"When a key object lacks a label, the code copies the certificate label into the key object; the label source is attacker-influenced through the synthetic card data and can trigger the reported stack-buffer-overflow read during object handling.","depends_on":[{"on":6,"type":"data","via":"constructed PKCS#15 object"}]}]
path=pathlib.Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
path.write_text(json.dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(path.read_text())
PY
bash ./submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/opensc/src/tests/fuzzing/fuzz_pkcs15_reader.c /workspace/candidate_trace.json
